author: Brian Bowman
title: Flyers volleyball swept by Cathedral - NewsBreak
text:
By Brian Bowman ,
14 hours ago The Little Falls Flyers were swept 3-0 by the St. Cloud Cathedral Crusaders in a Granite Ridge Conference match on Tuesday, Sept. 30.
St. Cloud won by scores of 25-18, 25-14, and 25-17.
Annika Halvorsen led Little Falls with seven kills, two blocks, and a set assist while Courtney Herdering added 16 set assists, four aces, two digs, and a block.
The Flyes’ other statistics came from Ellie Santala (set assist), Izzy Johnson (two aces, two digs), Sam Pint (kill, set assist, dig), Abby Henry (block), Kali Brigmon (six kills, ace, block), Carissa Olson (kill, set assist, dig), Gabby Dahlberg (dig), and Maiya Poppen (three kills, block).
On Monday, Sept. 29, Little Falls swept the St. Cloud Apollo Eagles 3-0 by scores of 25-4, 25-4, and 25-13.
Brigmon led Little Falls with 10 ace serves, 13 kills, a pair of digs, and a block.
Little Falls’ other individual statistics included Johnson (three ace serves, two digs), Kendra Robinson (three ace serves), Pint (kill, block), Henry (kill), Herdering (15 set assists, three ace serves), Abby Dawson (set assist, ace serve), Olson (ace serve, block), Halvorson (five kills, two blocks), Dahlberg (dig), and Poppen (ace serve).
Foley 3 Little Falls 0
Little Falls lost 3-0 to the Foley Falcons in a Granite Ridge Conference match on Thursday, Sept. 25.
Foley won by set scores of 25-18, 25-22, and 25-15.
Halvorson had four kills and three blocks for the Flyers while Herdering added 18 set assists and a pair of digs.
Little Falls’ other statistics included Henry (three kills, block), Brigmon (nine kills, ace, block), Olson (kill), Halvorson (four kills, three blocks), Dahlberg (ace, three digs), and Poppen (four kills, two set assists, ace, two blocks).
Little Falls will host the Albany Huskies on Tuesday, Oct. 7 and then play at the Pierz Pioneers Thursday, Oct. 9. Both matches will start at 7 p.m.
Pierz falls to Milaca
Pierz was also in action on Tuesday, Sept. 30, losing 3-1 to the Milaca Wolves in a Granite Ridge Conference match.
Milaca won by set scores of 25-12, 22-25, 25-20, and 25-15.
Mataya Pohlkamp paced the Pioneers with 11 kills, eight digs, and a block while Sophia Leidenfrost led Pierz with 25 digs, a kill, and a set assist.
Pierz’s other statistics came from Shelby Pulak (seven digs, two set assists), Kora Toops (nine digs, block, three kills), Autumn Jones (two ace serves, dig, block, three kills), Payton Kimman (dig, set assist), Macy Sadlovsky (two ace serves, 11 digs), Brooklyn Hanneken (three ace serves, six digs, 30 set assists), Eva Schlieman (two digs, a block, eight kills), Amber Boser (11 digs, two blocks, eight kills), and Kate Hoheisel (block, two kills).
Pierz (4-14 overall, 1-8 conference) hosted Foley on Thursday, Oct. 2, but no score was available at press time.
The Pioneers will host Pequot Lakes on Tuesday, Oct. 7 at 7 p.m.
